featured_reviews.name: I'M YouNick
featured_reviews.review_text:
Not a genuine motor training school — feels like a scam.

The training is extremely poor. Every day, the trainer just makes one short round of Govind Nagar for about 20 minutes, repeated for nearly 20 days. There is no structured learning or progression.

Most of the time, the trainer simply sits and watches, giving instructions only about steering and corners. No real driving techniques are taught. The trainer uses an emergency clutch and brake system throughout the sessions, so the learner never actually gets a chance to properly pick up the car from first gear. The trainer does it from his side, but the learner is left with the false impression that they are doing it themselves. This continues for the entire training period.

Important real-world driving skills are completely ignored, such as:
-Handling bumper-to-bumper traffic
-Proper clutch–brake coordination with mild acceleration
-Driving on slopes or hill starts
-Managing traffic on inclined roads

Overall, this feels more like a money-making setup than a real driving school. I strongly recommend choosing a reputed and genuine car driving school if you want proper training and confidence on the road.

featured_reviews.name: ADITYA
featured_reviews.review_text:
I strongly advise anyone looking for a driving school to stay far away from this place. My experience here was nothing short of a nightmare, and I feel it’s my responsibility to warn others before they waste their hard-earned money.
​1. Unprofessional and Mean Staff:
The instructors here are incredibly rude and have zero patience. Instead of teaching, they spend the entire time being mean-spirited and condescending. It’s an incredibly stressful environment that is the exact opposite of what a student driver needs.
​2. The "5-Minute" Rip-off:
This is the biggest issue. They advertised a full lesson, but I was only allowed behind the wheel for 5-10 minutes per session. Despite the extremely short time, they had the audacity to charge me even more than the agreed-upon price. It is a blatant bait-and-switch tactic.
​3. Hostile Management:
When I tried to calmly address these issues with the owner, I was met with even more hostility. The owner is just as rude and mean as the instructors. They clearly have no interest in customer service or providing a quality education; they only care about extracting as much money as possible for as little work as possible.
​Conclusion:
This school is a complete "money-grab" operation. Between the disrespectful treatment and the predatory pricing for 5-10 minute per sessions, it is a total scam. Save yourself the headache and the money—go to a professional school that actually cares about its students.

featured_reviews.name: Vaibhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
UNPROFESSIONAL, DISHONEST, AND A TOTAL WASTE OF MONEY
DO NOT SIGN UP HERE. I am writing this to save anyone else from making the mistake I did. This "training school" is a complete scam that takes your hard-earned money and delivers absolutely nothing in return.
1. Financial Dishonesty & Rude Management:
After paying the full fees, my sessions were immediately cut short. Instead of the promised time, I am lucky if I get 10 minutes behind the wheel. When I politely confronted the owner about this, he was incredibly aggressive and rude. He flat-out refused to refund my money or provide the training sessions I paid for. He has zero professional ethics and clearly doesn't care about his students once he has their cash.
2. Zero Actual Learning:
The "training" is a joke. For the few minutes I am actually in the driver's seat, the instructor is the one really driving. He keeps his feet on the dual controls and steers for me, meaning I’m not learning any actual car control or gaining confidence. It’s a complete waste of time if you actually want to pass a driving test.
3. Disgusting Vehicle Conditions:
The car itself is a nightmare. It is in the worst mechanical condition I have ever seen—it feels unsafe to be on the road. To make matters worse, the interior smells like absolute trash. It is filthy, unhygienic, and the driver/instructor is just as unpleasant to be around.
4. The Verdict:
This place is predatory. They lure you in, take your money, and then treat you with contempt while providing a substandard, smelly, and useless service. Save your sanity, your money, and your nose—go to any other driving school but this one.
